title: 第1444章 寻找阿瞳第1443章 得召唤海神法阵
lines: 无名界面，黑色殿宇前方。
原本端坐在红色光圈中的干瘪老者，蓦然间便口里喷出了一阵血雾。
“咦？老黑，发生了何事？”
水池中，缩在龟壳里的老龟，瞬间便伸长了脖子，朝干瘪老者问道。
“该死，下界中，竟然有位人族修士，敢朝我出手，还将我的血食化身，给斩了！”
“等下次再有人召唤，本仙下去后，一定得先将那位人族修士给灭了！！！”
干瘪老者看着老龟，口中愤愤地说道。
“那片海域，我记得主人之前曾提过，因为牵扯到某位大人物，被几位大仙联手放逐了，眼下应该不会有太强的修士诞生才是，怎么会有人族修士能伤到你？”
老龟对此显然很感兴趣，伸长着脖子继续问道：“莫非，这次的血食太少，凝聚不出高阶法身？”
“哼，我虽然许久未曾享用血食了，但若是血食太少，我也不可能下界的。”
“你刚说的那片海域被放逐之事，我自然也听主人说过，只不过据我感知，那里的天地灵气，却已经开始恢复了，也不知是不是放逐之事，有所改变？”干瘪老者气愤稍减地道。
“灵气恢复了？”老龟闻言，脖子却微微一缩，“此事不能轻视，或许等主人出关后，得第一时间汇报给他老人家了。”
“不行！你若是将此事汇报，那我偷偷下界之事，岂不是要被主人知晓了？”干瘪老者面色大急地道。
“呵呵……”老龟呵呵一笑，然后接着道：“老黑，偷偷下界这等小过，与发现放逐之地松动比起来，哪个更重要？”
“说不定主人得知此事，不仅不会处罚你，还会有所奖赏呢。”
干瘪老者闻言，眼珠子微微一转，这才不再坚持。
震退妖族后不久，李卓阳便已返回逍遥城。
不过，这次回来，李卓阳并未直接进入洞府闭关，而是找来了韩盈盈，听取了这次大战，人族的伤亡情况，以及逍遥城的收获。
然后又主动拿出礁岛主的元神，以天宝祭灵术，将其炼入了斩龙剑之中。
这样，斩龙剑凭借这次重新祭炼，直接冲入了玄天灵器的级别。
尽管，这件灵器只达到了中品玄器的品阶，但是有剑灵的加持以及龙竹天然压制龙族妖兽的属性，此宝的威力绝对不亚于上品玄器。
在星沙海域，即便有着十多万年传承的藏剑门、玲珑宗之中，都没有这等级别的宝物。
因为在十多万年的传承中，那三位万法宗炼虚境修士带来的宝物，也早因为无灵力滋养，而彻底损坏了。
升级好斩龙剑后，李卓阳又亲自给韩盈盈炼制了三枚化神丹。
同时他又将一些早已用不到的蕴神丹、天罗丹、定元丹等五阶丹药，以及这些丹药的丹方，甚至包括一些五阶符箓的绘制之法，都给了韩盈盈。
“哥，你……是又打算走了吗？”
韩盈盈看到李卓阳的这些举动，当即面带忧色地问道。
她虽然早已情牵那个诞生自主神智的分身，但李卓阳毕竟也是她从小陪着一起长大的兄长，她自然还是有些许不舍的。
“呵呵，走肯定是要走的，但你也不要担心，我不会说走就走。”
content_en:
Nameless interface, in front of the black palace.
"Pfft..."
The wizened old man who was sitting in the red circle of light suddenly spurted a burst of blood mist from his mouth.
"Eh? Lao Hei, what happened?"
In the pool, the old turtle huddled in its shell stretched out its neck in an instant and asked the withered old man.
"Damn it, there was a human monk in the lower realm who dared to attack me and killed my blood-food incarnation!"
"When someone calls me next time, after I go down, I must kill the human monk first!!!"
The wizened old man looked at the old turtle and said angrily.
"In that sea area, I remember that the master mentioned it before. Because it involved a certain big shot, it was banished by several great immortals. There shouldn't be any strong monks born at the moment. How could a human monk be able to hurt you?"
The old turtle was obviously very interested in this. He stretched his neck and continued to ask: "Is it possible that the blood food this time is too little to condense the high-level Dharma Body?"
"Hmph, although I haven't enjoyed blood food for a long time, if there was too little blood food, I wouldn't be able to go down to the lower world."
"I have naturally heard from my master about the exile in the sea area you just mentioned. However, according to my perception, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth there has begun to recover. I wonder if the exile has changed?" The wizened old man said with less anger.
"Has your spiritual energy recovered?" Old Turtle shrank his neck slightly when he heard this, "This matter cannot be taken lightly. Perhaps after the master comes out of seclusion, he will have to report it to his old man as soon as possible."
"No! If you report this matter, wouldn't it mean that my master will find out about me secretly going down to the next world?" The wizened old man said with a serious look on his face.
"Haha..." Old Turtle chuckled, and then continued: "Old Hei, which is more important than a small offense like sneaking into the lower realm or discovering that the place of exile is loose?"
"Maybe if the master learns about this, not only will he not punish you, but he will also reward you."
When the wizened old man heard this, his eyes rolled slightly, and then he stopped insisting.
…
Not long after repelling the demon clan, Li Zhuoyang returned to Xiaoyao City.
However, when he came back this time, Li Zhuoyang did not directly enter the cave for retreat. Instead, he found Han Yingying and listened to the battle, the casualties of the human race, and the harvest of Xiaoyao City.
Then he took the initiative to take out the soul of the reef island owner, used the Heavenly Treasure Spirit Sacrifice Technique, and refined it into the Dragon-Slaying Sword.
In this way, with this re-sacrifice, the Dragon-Slaying Sword directly entered the level of Xuantian's spiritual weapon.
Although this spiritual weapon has only reached the level of a middle-grade mysterious weapon, with the blessing of the sword spirit and the dragon bamboo's natural attribute of suppressing dragon monsters, the power of this treasure is definitely no less than that of a high-grade mysterious weapon.
In the Star Sand Sea, even the Hidden Sword Sect and Linglong Sect, which have a heritage of more than 100,000 years, do not have treasures of this level.
Because in the inheritance of more than 100,000 years, the treasures brought by the three Wanfa Sect monks in the Void Refining Realm have long been completely damaged due to lack of spiritual power to nourish them.
After upgrading the Dragon-Slaying Sword, Li Zhuoyang personally refined three God Transformation Pills for Han Yingying.
At the same time, he gave Han Yingying some fifth-level elixirs such as Yunshen Pill, Tianluo Pill, and Dingyuan Pill that were no longer needed, as well as the prescriptions for these elixirs, and even some drawing methods for fifth-level talismans.
"Brother, are you... planning to leave again?"
When Han Yingying saw Li Zhuoyang's actions, she immediately asked with a worried look on her face.
Although she has long been in love with the clone who was born with independent sanity, Li Zhuoyang is also the brother she grew up with, so naturally she is still a little reluctant to let him go.
"Haha, I definitely have to leave, but don't worry, I won't just leave."
